title: Natural gas production (EI via OWID)

indicator.name: Natural gas production
indicator.description: Gas production: Measured in terawatt-hours. Excludes gas flared or recycled. Includes natural gas produced for Gas-to-Liquids transformation.

source.name: Our World in Data – Energy dataset (Energy Institute Statistical Review data)
source.license: Our World in Data processing: CC BY 4.0. Underlying data: Energy Institute Statistical Review, free to use with citation (see upstream).
source.citation: Energy Institute – Statistical Review of World Energy (2026) – with major processing by Our World in Data. File owid_energy.csv downloaded from https://catalog.ourworldindata.org/energy/owid_energy/owid_energy.csv on 2026-10-12 19:10 UTC (server Last-Modified: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 14:42:02 GMT).

upstream.name: Energy Institute – Statistical Review of World Energy (2026)
upstream.license: Free to access, citation required ("Energy Institute – Statistical Review of World Energy (2026)"); no open licence is stated on the EI pages checked on 2026-10-12

notes: Imported from data/raw/owid/owid_energy.csv, column "gas_production_twh", years 1990 on (one row per country and year; the latest year with a value is shown, the full series is kept for charts and derived datasets).

Codebook (data/raw/owid/owid_energy.codebook.csv) title: "Gas production"; unit: "terawatt-hours (TWh)"; sources: Energy Institute – Statistical Review of World Energy (2026); Etemad & Luciani – World Energy Production 1800–1985 (1991); U.S. Energy Information Administration – International Energy Data (2026).

Rows with a blank iso_code are matched by their "country" name: Kosovo -> XKX; regions, income groups and source-defined aggregates (e.g. "Europe (EI)", "G20 (Ember)", "World") and former states are skipped. A blank cell is kept as missing, never 0.
caveats: OWID fills production for countries not covered by EI from other sources (EIA, historical datasets); the dependence is only computed where EI supply also exists.

scoring.rationale: Input to the fuel net-import dependence; absolute volume on its own.
